component.name: Lodestar
component.summary: A game launcher for your whole library, from desk to couch

description.p: Lodestar puts every game you own in one fast library: Steam, Heroic (Epic, GOG, Amazon), Lutris, Bottles, itch, emulated consoles, cloud gaming and the programs you add yourself. It finds them on its own, fills in covers, artwork and descriptions, and starts each game the right way.
At the desk it looks like a tidy game library window. On the couch it turns into a full-screen, themeable controller mode that works entirely with a gamepad.

ul.li: Finds the games of your stores and launchers automatically, with a manual way to add anything else
Emulation: detects installed emulators, recognises your ROMs and checks BIOS files
Controller mode with themes, including a visual theme creator
Play time, completion status, favourites, tags, collections and statistics
Keeps store launchers out of sight while you play
One small program: idle means no CPU, nothing to install alongside it

screenshot.caption: The game library on the desktop
A game's page with its details
Browsing a console's games in controller mode

description.p: Use a controller in desktop mode, choose which categories controller mode shows (including all PC games), games no longer in your Steam library are marked, a first-start step for complete artwork, more covers for emulated games, and imported Playnite themes look closer to their originals.
Fixes games added to Steam or the app menu by another launcher showing up twice, and new games sometimes showing a removed game's pictures. You can now delete your own themes in the theme creator.
Lodestar updates itself: it tells you when a new version is out, shows what's new and installs it in one click; automatic checks can be switched off and versions skipped.
Works with the new Steam beta, lists Steam games you own but haven't installed even when Steam's files don't name them, and gives every dialog its buttons in the same place.
The theme creator: make your own controller theme on a live preview of your library, with colour schemes, variants and console pictures, and share it as a .zip.
